reasons: Local or external contributor run: encouraged for fast feedback, restricted to read-only cache and non-authoritative gates.

categories.name: safety
categories.title: Safety & TigerStyle
categories.description: Crash-free EVM execution, error propagation, and type-safety across Zig and TypeScript.

metrics.name: zig-no-panic
metrics.title: Zig no panic
metrics.description: Never use @panic or unreachable in production src/ Zig code; validate and return typed errors.

metrics.name: zig-no-debug-print
metrics.title: Zig no debug print
metrics.description: Replace std.debug.print in production src/ Zig modules with logger.zig.

metrics.name: zig-no-swallowed-errors
metrics.title: Zig no swallowed errors
metrics.description: Never swallow errors with empty catch {} or leave error.NotImplemented stubs in production Zig code.

metrics.name: zig-assertion-density
metrics.title: Zig assertion density
metrics.description: Add invariant assertions to production Zig functions to raise assertion density toward TigerStyle targets.

metrics.name: ts-no-explicit-any
metrics.title: Ts no explicit any
metrics.description: Replace explicit `any` annotations and `as any` casts in ts/ with narrow types.

metrics.name: ts-no-suppress
metrics.title: Ts no suppress
metrics.description: Fix underlying TypeScript errors instead of using @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, or @ts-nocheck.

categories.name: style
categories.title: Style & Limits
categories.description: TigerStyle structural bounds (70-line functions, 120-char lines) and canonical Zig formatting.

metrics.name: zig-fmt
metrics.title: Zig fmt
metrics.description: Keep all Zig files in src/ formatted with `zig fmt`.

metrics.name: function-length
metrics.title: Function length
metrics.description: Keep every production Zig runtime function at or below 70 lines (TigerStyle limit).

metrics.name: line-length
metrics.title: Line length
metrics.description: Keep production Zig lines at or below 120 characters (TigerStyle limit).

metrics.name: no-todo-markers
metrics.title: No todo markers
metrics.description: Resolve TODO, FIXME, XXX, and HACK markers in production Zig and TypeScript modules.

categories.name: footprint
categories.title: Footprint & Minimalism
categories.description: Minimal EVM source footprint, WASM surface compactness, and module size budgets.

metrics.name: zig-file-lines
metrics.title: Zig file lines
metrics.description: Keep production Zig files concise (<=400 lines) to preserve guillotine-mini's minimal architecture.

metrics.name: wasm-surface-bytes
metrics.title: Wasm surface bytes
metrics.description: Keep core EVM modules under src/ and wasm/ compact to protect the <=2.5 MiB WASM binary budget.

metrics.name: ts-file-lines
metrics.title: Ts file lines
metrics.description: Keep TypeScript modules under ts/ concise (<=300 lines per file).

categories.name: verification
categories.title: Verification & Tests
categories.description: Lean 4 formal oracle proofs, Zig inline unit tests, and TypeScript test coverage.

metrics.name: lean-no-sorry
metrics.title: Lean no sorry
metrics.description: Never leave `sorry` or unproved `axiom` declarations in spec/lean/**/*.lean.

metrics.name: lean-theorems
metrics.title: Lean theorems
metrics.description: Expand Lean 4 reference specification proofs in spec/lean/ toward complete opcode/fork coverage.

metrics.name: zig-inline-test-coverage
metrics.title: Zig inline test coverage
metrics.description: Include inline `test` blocks inside production src/ Zig modules.

metrics.name: ts-test-ratio
metrics.title: Ts test ratio
metrics.description: Pair every production TypeScript module in ts/ with dedicated unit tests.

categories.name: documentation
categories.title: Documentation
categories.description: Companion *.zig.md design docs and local markdown link integrity.

metrics.name: broken-links
metrics.title: Broken links
metrics.description: Fix broken relative and root-relative links in root Markdown files and docs/**/*.md.

metrics.name: companion-doc-coverage
metrics.title: Companion doc coverage
metrics.description: Maintain companion `*.zig.md` design documentation alongside top-level production `src/*.zig` modules.

categories.name: factory
categories.title: Factory & Trust

metrics.name: factory-projection-sync
metrics.title: Factory projection sync

metrics.name: trust-boundary-guard
metrics.title: Trust boundary guard
